none: PAS CAM-E396D7: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [...]PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is Trier, AD347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]PF AVG. Reverse shows Two Victories with wreaths. Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN. Reverse fields and exergue reads: (symbol)//[TRP]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.25g, diameter is 15.52mm.
